title: When family problems break your heart… God is still near.
paragraphs: When family problems break your heart… God is still near.
Some of the hardest prayers happen in the quiet — sitting alone, tears falling, asking God to fix what feels impossible.
“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.” — Psalm 34:18
If you’re going through family struggles right now, you are not alone. God sees every tear and hears every prayer.
Healing may take time, but God is already working behind the scenes.
